reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding* in `main...dedupe-imports` at `62644c3`:

*High — deduplication uses object identity instead of contact ID* — `src/dedupe.js:2`
`new Set(contacts)` only removes repeated references to the same object. Overlapping imports contain separate objects with equal IDs, so duplicates survive through `mergeImports`, violating the documented contract.

Reproduced with:
```js
mergeImports(
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }],
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada updated' }]
)
```
Expected: only the first contact. Actual: both contacts remain.

*Suggested fix:* track seen `contact.id` values and retain the first object for each ID. Add regression tests for distinct objects sharing an ID, both directly through `dedupe` and across lists through `mergeImports`. The current dedupe test repeats the same object, so it misses this case.

All 4 existing tests pass; the additional overlap checks fail. No files changed. I’d fix this before merging.
